messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert PD-7234 fired for cluster/gpu-pool-gamma — High GPU memory pressure / repeated cudaMalloc failures. Symptoms: OOMs, kernel warnings. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-7234

pagerduty: PD-7234 assigned to Maria G (oncall).

Maria G: Acked in PagerDuty. Pulling logs now. I see a lot of `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` from serving pods in eu-west-1.

Chris K: I'm on it — ssh'ing to host gpu-13. Running `nvidia-smi` to check processes.

Chris K: `nvidia-smi` shows node gpu-13 at 98% memory, processes are mostly serving-13b with big KV cache.

Maria G: Customer impact: we have latency spikes and ~5% increase in 500s for redwood-13b (eu-west-1). CS has been pinged.

Tom H: Looking at heap/logs — KV cache growth seems unbounded for a subset of requests (large prefixes). Might be a bad prompt pattern causing cache blowup.

Chris K: Temporary mitigation idea: reduce batch size and lower max_concurrency on the pods in pool-gamma, and route new traffic to pool-beta. That should relieve memory pressure.

Jess L: @Chris K I can flip routing if you push the config. Also can start a rolling restart if needed.

Chris K: Patch ready: diff of service config -> set batch_size: 1, max_concurrency: 2 for pool-gamma. Command: `kubectl apply -f routing-patch.yaml`.

Tom H: I'll run a cache-evict for redwood-13b prefixes that are > 8k tokens, script: `./scripts/evict_kv_cache --model redwood-13b --threshold 8000`. Starting it now.

deploy-bot: Rolling restart initiated for deployment inference/serving-13b by Chris K.

Chris K: restart done for first 3 pods. Memory usage on gpu-13 dropped to ~65% so far.

Maria G: Good sign. However seeing intermittent `cudaMalloc` spikes still in logs. Recording TL;DR metrics and adding to incident doc.

Tom H: Evict script completed on pool-gamma. KV cache sizes back to expected range.

Jess L: I've pushed routing change to divert 40% traffic to pool-beta and 60% to pool-gamma with new limits. Watching error rate.

Chris K: Error rate dropped from 5% -> 1.2% in last 3 mins. Latency tail improving.

pagerduty: PD-7234 acknowledged by Maria G. Escalation window set to 30m if unresolved.

Maria G: Customer impact note added: redwood-13b eu-west-1 degraded for 00:28 — 00:42 UTC window, affecting primarily autocompletions and streaming endpoints. CS notified for high-touch customers.

Tom H: I need to step out for ~30m (dinner). Handing off to Jess L. Jess — will leave logs and runbook notes in the incident doc.

Jess L: Taking over. I'll stick on pager and continue monitoring for 30m. If error rate rises > 3% for 10m, escalate to SRE rotation.

Chris K: Quick note — I spotted a few `cudaGetErrorString` lines pointing to a driver mismatch on one host (gpu-14). Opening a ticket to infra to check driver versions across the fleet. That might explain some sporadic allocation failures.

Maria G: Good catch. Tagging infra on the incident doc. For now, mitigation holds. I'll keep PD acknowledged and keep this thread open until we see a 20m stable window.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback available. No active rollout in progress.

Jess L: After 18 minutes of observation error rate stabilized at 0.6% and memory usage steady. I'm going to de-escalate but keep monitoring.

Maria G: After 42 minutes metrics back to baseline (latency and error rate). Planning a follow-up postmortem if driver mismatch confirmed. For now I'll resolve PD and mark as mitigated. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD-7234 resolved by Maria G.

Maria G: Closing thread. Postmortem ticket: PM-8342. Will include root cause hypothesis (driver mismatch + unbounded KV cache growth) and remediation steps (enforce KV cache caps, fleet driver check, add alert for per-pod KV growth).
